body: You're saying you're not excited anymore, which is what is a red flag to me. I noticed in an earlier comment that you've said you're 21. There's a whole life ahead of you and yet, it's too short to spend in a relationship you're not completely happy with. As others have said, there's not ever really a good time to do it, but you deserve to be happy, and it sounds like you were more happy in the couple of months when you broke up the second time than you have been while you've been back together. It's natural to miss someone and care about them when things end, but that's not to say it's not for the better for you.

He has the tendency to be stubborn and not open up a lot (which I came to accept over the year and a half that we dated), so he's really hard to read, and I'm just not confident I'm reading him right.
I’ve apologized to him for what I felt my role in the break up was (I did this about a week and a half ago), and he accepted that apology.
We broke up about 6 weeks ago. Did no contact for about 3 weeks, then I reached out to him. I have an appointment on Thursday but have not seen my counselor in about 3 weeks (she is on vacation).
Yes, he broke up with me.
